affect.va_classic module

Classic Valence-Arousal dimensional emotion model.

Implements the discrete dynamical frequency system and Core Affect calculations from Feldmaier and Diepold (2014): “Path-finding Using Reinforcement Learning and Affective States”.

class affect.va_classic.ClassicValenceArousal(nu: float = 0.2, theta1: float = 0.2, theta2: float = 0.2, kappa: float = 0.15, init_f_col: float = 0.0, init_f_dir: float = 0.0, init_f_goal: float = 0.0, init_f_right: float = 0.0)

Bases: object

Valence-Arousal emotion model based on Feldmaier and Diepold (2014).

Maintains four short-term memory frequency variables:

  • f_col: Frequency of wall collisions.

  • f_dir: Frequency of action direction changes.

  • f_goal: Frequency of target goal visibility.

  • f_right: Frequency of moving in the right direction (away from start).

nu

Slope factor for collision frequency update (default: 0.2).

Slope factor for direction change update (default: 0.2).

Type:

float

Slope factor for goal in sight update (default: 0.2).

Type:

float

kappa

Slope factor for right direction update (default: 0.15).

Type:

float

Current collision frequency in [-1.0, 1.0].

Current direction change frequency in [-1.0, 1.0].

Type:

float

reset() → None

Reset all frequency values and emotion coordinates to initial values.

update(collision: bool, dir_changed: bool, goal_in_sight: bool, distance_increasing: bool) → Dict[str, float]

Update discrete dynamical frequencies and compute Core Affect (V, A).

Equations from Feldmaier & Diepold (2014):

f_col(t) = f_col(t-1) + ( (1 if c else -1) - f_col(t-1) ) * nu f_dir(t) = f_dir(t-1) + ( (1 if d else -1) - f_dir(t-1) ) * theta1 f_goal(t) = f_goal(t-1) + ( (1 if g else -1) - f_goal(t-1) ) * theta2 f_right(t) = f_right(t-1) + ( (1 if i else -1) - f_right(t-1) ) * kappa A(t) = (f_dir + f_col) / 2 if g == 0 else (f_dir + f_col + f_goal) / 3 V(t) = (f_goal + f_right) / 2

Parameters:

  • collision (bool) – Whether agent collided with a wall in current step (c).

  • dir_changed (bool) – Whether current action changed from previous action (d).

  • goal_in_sight (bool) – Whether unblocked line of sight exists to goal (g).

  • distance_increasing (bool) – Whether distance to start increased (i = 1 or -1).

Returns:

Dictionary containing updated valence, arousal, and frequencies.

Return type:

Dict[str, float]

Module contents

Affective computing and emotional model package.

Provides models for computing Valence-Arousal core affect dynamics from sensory and reinforcement learning states.
